title: Uncertainty placement under train-deployment asymmetry: reference implementation for reliability-aware model-dependent uncertainty placement in probabilistic load forecasting
description:
Reference implementation for Reliability-Aware Model-Dependent Uncertainty Placement under Data Asymmetry for Probabilistic Load Forecasting (G. Ozdemir and S. Al-Shareeda).

The code compares a modular placement of uncertainty (post-hoc contextual residual quantiles) with an integrated placement (in-model quantile learning) for seven forecasters from five families: SARIMAX, XGBoost, BiLSTM, BiGRU-LSTM, the Temporal Fusion Transformer, and Chronos-T5-small in zero-tuned and fine-tuned form. Each model is evaluated under a symmetric protocol (training and deployment at 5-minute resolution with all channels) and an asymmetric protocol (deployment on hourly data with temperature and calendar features only) on the same test days. A script reproduces every aggregate number reported in the paper, including the scheduling, reserve and cost mapping.

Licensing. Code, notebooks, scripts and results are MIT. The two data files in data/ are CSV exports of the 2025 Competition on Electric Energy Consumption Forecast dataset (doi:10.5281/zenodo.16061225) and remain under CC BY 4.0. See LICENSE.
